_about: Resident population per state, used to turn lost MW into 'people without power' (an estimate): people = lost MW x population / the state model's load. Households are population / 2.5 people per household (about the U.S. average household size in the Census Bureau's American Community Survey), also an estimate.
source: U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2024 population estimates (NST-EST2024), resident population on July 1, 2024
